instruction: Extend state_reader.read(document) for version-1 dictionary records. Required v must be integer 1, count must be an integer 0..1000000000, and optional note is a string defaulting to empty. Booleans are not valid integer fields. Ignore unknown fields for forward compatibility. Return a new {"count":count,"note":note} dictionary, preserving input. Invalid/missing required fields or invalid note raise ValueError. Preserve state_writer.py and golden-state.json exactly; only state_reader.py may change. Writer serialization must remain version 1 without a new note field.
